day.headline: A Horse day — Tiger and Dog are in step.

reasons: Horse's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Pockets today. Leave the bag, walk out with both hands free.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You stopped asking months ago. Ask it again today, plainly.

reasons: Goat pairs with Horse — a harmonious day
signs.message: Phone rings at nine. Answer it, stay on a while.

reasons: Tiger and Horse share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Backwards seat's free. Sit in it, watch the city leave.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Blanked again. Ask once more, then save it in your phone.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a corner of the day nobody uses
signs.message: That dead hour after lunch. Put one small thing there.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the relief of a cancelled plan
signs.message: You're relieved it fell through. Don't reschedule it yet.

reasons: Dog and Horse share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a group chat plan going nowhere
signs.message: Forty messages, no plan. Name a day, let them argue.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Shoes off at the door tonight. Nothing else required.

reasons: Rat opposes Horse — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Still no name for that spot. Decide later this week.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: shoes at the back of the wardrobe
signs.message: Those good shoes stay buried today. Flats, no negotiation.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Take the corner by the glass. Sit there, no agenda.
